explanation: States that for every prime p, the p-adic integers ℤ_[p] (with their p-adic topology, acting additively and continuously) admit no faithful action on a connected Hausdorff topological n-manifold; this is the equivalent formulation given on Wikipedia (Hilbert–Smith conjecture) and Tao's blog. AddAction/ContinuousVAdd/FaithfulVAdd are the right additive notions for the additive group ℤ_[p]. Not assuming X second countable gives an equivalent problem (restrict to a component of the σ-compact invariant open set G·U, on which an open subgroup ≅ ℤ_p acts faithfully). Faithful.
